title: PBA: San Miguel comes back from 20 pts down to stun NLEX as Fajardo hits career milestone
summary: San Miguel pulled off an improbable comeback, erasing a 20-point deficit to stun NLEX, 135-133, in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup on Wednesday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
